CustomField.description: When checked, exposes the Clone (duplicate row) action on Repeater and Table sections. Passed as allow-clone to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Button text comes from Clone Action Button Label; for Table sections the clone modal uses Table Clone Action Modal Title/Subtitle. Subject to the Max limit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users duplicate a row in this repeater or table. Set the button label with Clone Action Button Label; cloning is blocked once the Max row limit is reached.
CustomField.label: Enable Clone Action
